mk.error.incomplete: A listing needs a title, a category and a country.
mk.settings.whereText: The listings that reach your country are shown first, and new listings start there. Saved in your account.
mk.how.1: A listing is sealed before it leaves your browser: everyone using a hub that serves this space reads it, relays see ciphertext. A listing for friends or a circle only they read.
mk.how.2: Search runs without plain words on the relays: a listing carries keyed codes of its category and the countries it reaches, and a search asks for the codes. Whoever knows the space computes them too, so this keeps a listing off plain view, it does not make it secret.
